note: There are no Brewmaster-specific per-dungeon guides, so Brewmaster's per-boss lines apply general principles from the Wowhead and Icy Veins Brewmaster guides (keep Shuffle up and Purifying Brew for physical tank busters, Celestial Infusion and Fortifying Brew for big hits, Detox for poison and disease) to each mechanic. Mechanic damage types were checked against in-game tooltips.

general.sub: Kit summary · Pick a hero talent above

i: Flurry Strikes build from auto attacks and all burst at once when you use Keg Smash
Pressing Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox instantly applies 10 stacks of Flurry Strikes (Stand Ready). Line it up with big pulls
It reduces damage taken through steady dodging, so it's strong on multi-target M+ pulls
Wowhead's recommended M+ hero talent. Its damage pulls ahead on 2+ targets
Aspect of Harmony stores part of your damage dealt and healing done as vitality
It strengthens defensive abilities like Purifying Brew and Celestial Infusion, so it suits raids with lots of big hits
Single-target damage is similar to Shado-Pan; AoE is lower than Shado-Pan
Stagger · Spreads part of the physical damage you take over 10s; 58% effectiveness against magic (passive)
Shuffle · Maintained by Keg Smash, Blackout Kick and Spinning Crane Kick; Stagger effectiveness +100%
Purifying Brew · 20s, 2 charges · Removes 50% of your current Stagger
Celestial Infusion · 1m 30s · Shield that absorbs 30% of damage taken
Fortifying Brew · 6m (shortened by the Expeditious Fortification talent) · 15s, Stagger effectiveness +15%
Black Ox Brew · 2m · Refills Energy and Purifying Brew charges, grants 1 extra Celestial Infusion
Invoke Niuzao, the Black Ox · 2m · Takes 40% of your Stagger damage for 25s
Tiger's Lust · 30s · Ally movement speed +70%, removes roots and snares
Never let Shuffle drop, and clear built-up Stagger with Purifying Brew. For big tank busters, Celestial Infusion/Fortifying Brew
Spear Hand Strike 15s interrupt. Backups: Leg Sweep (AoE stun), Paralysis, Ring of Peace
Detox: dispels poison and disease (recommended by Icy Veins in 7 dungeons)
Gather scattered pulls by placing Summon Black Ox Statue and using Provoke on the statue
Tiger's Lust for roots and snares; move with Roll and Transcendence. Brewmaster has no battle res
Devour week: dispel the shield with Detox, and clear the snare with Tiger's Lust
Ascendant week: handle groups of orbs with Leg Sweep or Ring of Peace, single ones with Spear Hand Strike/Paralysis
Pulsar week: Roll to go take orbs, Tiger's Lust if needed
+12 and above, Xal'atath's Guile: each death removes 15 seconds

master-of-harmony.title: Master of Harmony Key Points
items: Tank busters to split {Celestial Infusion} and {Purifying Brew} across: {busters}
Spend the vitality stored by {Aspect of Harmony} during big pulls and boss burst windows

Rav'i: [탱버] Hydrastrike is three heads hitting in a row for Physical damage, so take it with Shuffle up and clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after. The only tank threats here are Physical melee and Hydrastrike, so use Celestial Infusion right before Hydrastrike when your health is low.
[참고] Hydrastrike replaces melee, so Mastery: Elusive Brawler still dodges it, but it does not trigger Counterstrike or Predictive Training (Shado-Pan build) (Wowhead).
[해제] Detox Regurgitate (Disease) off affected party members right away. If Detox is on cooldown, Tiger's Lust also removes it (Wowhead).
[위치] If the empty pile without Fresh Meat is far, Roll there early and drag the boss over before energy hits 0.
The Writhing Coil: [탱버] Take Tail Scythe (3 sec cast, 678877 Physical) with Shuffle up and clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after. Use Celestial Infusion when Tail Scythe lands on top of the 35 sec Synchronized Venom Nature DoT.
[차단] Put Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) into the three-kick Toxic Atrophy rotation. After Uncoil, you may stop the Uncoiled Writhes' Toxic Atrophy with Leg Sweep instead of a kick (Wowhead).

[위치] During Death Rattle, Roll to stretch Vine Grip 10 yards quickly and trigger Uncoil sooner (Wowhead). Stun the 5 gathered Uncoiled Writhes together with Leg Sweep (10 yards with Tiger Tail Sweep).
[해제] Detox Spiteful Venom (Poison) stacks and clear Toxic Atrophy slow stacks with Tiger's Lust (Wowhead).
Zul'jan: [탱버] Chop Down (1.5 sec cast, 484912 Physical twice) has a short cast, so keep Shuffle up ahead of time with Keg Smash and Blackout Kick and clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after. Add Celestial Infusion if your health is low.
[탱버] Ritual Venom you fail to clear bursts for 387930 Nature after 50 sec, and Stagger only works at 58% against it, so use Celestial Infusion before your remaining stacks burst.
[위치] Use Roll when you move the boss to the edge after Axegrinder or when your assigned beam spot is far.

Lightblossom Trinity: [탱버] Bedrock Slam (484912 Physical + 193965 Nature) follows soon after the Lightblossom Beam soak, so keep Shuffle up with Keg Smash and Blackout Kick while you block the beam, then clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after the hit.
[탱버] If you also took Fertile Loam Nature ticks while blocking the beam, add Celestial Infusion for Bedrock Slam.
[차단] Kick Kezkitt's Light Bolt with Spear Hand Strike.
[위치] If the three bosses drift apart, grab one with Provoke and drag it to the others.
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] Use Tiger's Lust on allies held by Bloodthorn Roots, especially the Bloodthirsty Gaze target. If you are rooted yourself, break your root with Touch of Death (Wowhead).
[탱버] Stagger only works at 58% against Thorncaller Roar (Nature) and the post-50% Lightcrazed Frenzy (Holy every 2 sec), so save Celestial Infusion for the Frenzy phase.
[탱버] Clear Stagger built from Verdant Stomp's Physical damage with Purifying Brew and hold through Frenzy.
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Warden's Wrath in Moonkin Form is repeated Nature damage on the tank and Stagger only works at 58% against it, so kick it with Spear Hand Strike. If several land in a row, use Celestial Infusion.
[탱버] Keep Shuffle up throughout Bear Form. The Grievous Thrash bleed only drops at full health, so clear Stagger with Purifying Brew and top yourself off with Expel Harm.
[탱버] Split Celestial Infusion and Fortifying Brew across the 40% Spirits of the Vale phase.
Ziekket: [탱버] Thornspike is 193965 Holy plus a 10 sec Physical bleed (58189 per sec), and Stagger only works at 58% on the Holy part, so use Celestial Infusion on the cast and clear Stagger with Purifying Brew once the bleed builds.
[위치] When Lashers spawn, step into the middle of them and grab threat with Keg Smash and Breath of Fire. Gather stragglers with Provoke on Summon Black Ox Statue.
[차단] Kick Lightspore Shot from Lashers before they revive with Spear Hand Strike, and Leg Sweep them when several cast at once. Revived Lashers are immune to interrupts and crowd control.

The Hoardmonger: [해제] Detox (8 sec) Toxic Spores (Poison) only after every Spoiled Supplies mushroom is soaked, starting with the highest stacks. Up to 4 stacks is manageable (Wowhead, Topicx).

[탱버] Ravenous Bellow (armor-ignoring party Physical 164870 plus a 10 sec DoT) is absorbed by Stagger, so take it with Shuffle up and clear it with Purifying Brew. Use Celestial Infusion when your Toxic Spores Nature DoT stacks get high.
[위치] The tank also soaks 3-4 mushrooms each time, so Roll to far mushrooms and step on them within 12 sec.
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Kick Winter's Shroud from the Fractured Shivercore next to the boss with Spear Hand Strike (15 sec), and stun it with Leg Sweep if the kick is missed.

[탱버] Frozen Tempest and Glacial Torment are Frost damage and only get 58% Stagger, so line up Celestial Infusion with Frozen Tempest. If you end up outside the Snowdrift, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew and stack it.
[위치] If no one can soak Rimeshatter, Roll over to soak it yourself and heal up with Expel Harm. Free party members rooted by Rime Detonation with Tiger's Lust (Wowhead).
Nalorakk: [탱버] Fortifying Brew (15 sec) used on the Overwhelming Onslaught cast (armor-ignoring 315193 Physical three times) also covers the Forceful Slam (775859 Physical within 6 yards) after the knockback. Clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after.

[탱버] When Fortifying Brew is down for Onslaught, use Celestial Infusion and Invoke Niuzao; if those are down too, refill a Celestial Infusion charge with Black Ox Brew so every Onslaught has one defensive.
[탱버] If you are targeted by Echoing Maul, the Echo's 193965 Nature only gets 58% Stagger, so use any remaining Celestial Infusion. Heal up with Expel Harm when Spectral Slash DoTs stack.

Kystia Manaheart: [탱버] Press Celestial Infusion before the first Chaos Barrage hit, and clear the Stagger built up afterward with Purifying Brew.
[차단] Interrupt one Mirror Image with Spear Hand Strike, and stop Felstorm from the stacked clones with Leg Sweep.
[해제] Corroding Spittle can't be removed with Detox, so leave it to the healer.
Zaen Bladesorrow: [탱버] Melee damage peaks right after you drag the worker pack in, so use Invoke Niuzao and Fortifying Brew with the second Bloodlust and throw Exploding Keg (100% reduced melee damage for 3 sec) on the workers.
[탱버] Take Envenom (436421 Physical) with Shuffle up and Celestial Infusion stacked, then clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after.
[해제] Detox the Heartstop Poison (Poison, 30% max health reduction) applied by Envenom off yourself right away (Wowhead).
Xathuux the Annihilator: [탱버] Take Legion Strike (533403 Physical) with Shuffle up, and during the 8 sec 80% healing reduction, spend extra Purifying Brew charges even at low Stagger to protect your health (Wowhead).
[탱버] The boss gains 75% attack speed for 15 sec during Demonic Rage, so use Fortifying Brew. Use Celestial Infusion for the Infernal Crush (Fire) window after Axe Toss.
[위치] Use Roll to move the boss quickly toward the Axe Toss axe.
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Kick Chaos Bolt with Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) and stun Wild Imp packs with Leg Sweep (10 yards with Tiger Tail Sweep) to stop Felfire Burst.
[탱버] Furious Vilefiend adds 38793 Shadow damage to every melee hit through Shadow Bite and Stagger only works at 58% against it, so use Celestial Infusion when a Vilefiend spawns.

[위치] Roll the boss to the farthest corner right at the start. If you miss the Demonic Gateway for Malefic Wave, Transcendence: Transfer can dodge it, but demons hit by the wave gain Malefic Empowerment (100% haste), so clear adds first (Wowhead).

Taz'Rah: [탱버] Void Blast (2 sec cast, 271551 Shadow + knockback) only gets 58% Stagger, so use Celestial Infusion every time. When Celestial Infusion is down, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew. Master of Harmony has 2 charges from Endless Draught, making it easier to alternate.
[위치] When the boss lands in the middle, grab it right away with Provoke and drag it toward the outer wall away from the Ethereal Shades. If Void Blast pushes you away, Roll back into position.
Atroxus: [탱버] Hulking Claw (242456 Nature + 10 sec Nature DoT) only gets 58% Stagger, so use Celestial Infusion. Claw comes often, so when Celestial Infusion is down, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew, and if that is also down, cover it with Expel Harm (15 sec) and a potion.
[해제] Detox Mind-Numbing Poison (Poison, 30% haste reduction) applied by Poison Splash and Poison Pool (Wowhead).
[회피] A Toxic Creeper bite applies Sickening Bite, increasing Nature damage taken by 50% per stack for 5 min and making Hulking Claw much harder, so Roll away if one is about to catch you (Wowhead).
Charonus: [탱버] Dark Waves (5 sec cast, 339438 Shadow) only gets 58% Stagger, so use Celestial Infusion, and refill a charge with Black Ox Brew when it is down.
[해제] Put Tiger's Lust on party members with stacked Condensed Mass slows from Gravitic Orbs (Wowhead).
[참고] If Cosmic Crash DoTs drop party health, help party members in trouble with Vivify.

The Golden Serpent: [탱버] Tail Thrash (1.5 sec cast, 630386 Physical) is absorbed by Stagger, so have Shuffle up before the cast and clear it with Purifying Brew right after the hit.
[제어] Stop Animated Gold packs running to the boss with Leg Sweep, or push them away with Ring of Peace in front of the boss.
[위치] When moving the boss to the corner behind the stairs or dragging it toward the exit near the end, Roll over the gold pools to reposition.
Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Spear Hand Strike into the Wretched Discharge of Half-Finished and Finished Mummies first. A missed Wretched Discharge is a Disease, so remove it with Detox (8 sec).
[위치] If awakened mummies scatter, drop Summon Black Ox Statue next to the boss near the middle of the room and gather them with Provoke on the statue.
[위치] When Entomb goes out, Roll from the middle of the room straight to the shaking crypt and open it.
The Council of Tribes: [탱버] Aka'ali's Debilitating Backhand (2 sec cast, 727368 Physical) cannot be avoided, so use Fortifying Brew before the cast. On the next one without Fortifying Brew, take it with Celestial Infusion and Purifying Brew, then kite the boss with Roll and Tiger's Lust until Shattered Defenses ends (Wowhead).
[탱버] Arc Lightning (Nature) hits the tank from the moment Zanazal is engaged and only gets 58% Stagger, so use Celestial Infusion.
[차단] Assign Spear Hand Strike to Zanazal's Poison Nova, and Detox the poison if a cast gets through.
Dazar, The First King: [탱버] Save Fortifying Brew and Celestial Infusion in phase 1 and hold with Shuffle and Purifying Brew. After 80%, when Blade Combo follows T'zala's Savage Maul (Physical + 10 sec bleed, 10% increased Physical damage taken), use Fortifying Brew and clear Stagger with Purifying Brew once Blade Combo ends.
[탱버] Use Celestial Infusion for the next Savage Maul and Blade Combo overlap, and refill a charge with Black Ox Brew when Celestial Infusion is down.
[차단] Assign Spear Hand Strike to Reban's Deathly Roar, and grab T'zala with Provoke as soon as it appears at 80%.

Melidrussa Chillworn: [차단] The tank kicks the Frigid Shard that comes right after Hailburst ice lands with Spear Hand Strike and drags the boss off the ice.

[탱버] If Spear Hand Strike is on cooldown and Frigid Shard (775859 Physical) gets through, take it with Shuffle up and clear it with Purifying Brew right after. If you take several in a row, use Celestial Infusion.
[위치] When Infused Whelps spawn at 66% and 33%, drop Summon Black Ox Statue next to the boss and gather the whelps on top of the boss with Provoke on the statue (Wowhead).
[해제] Use Tiger's Lust on party members whose Cold Claws stacks from the whelps are nearing 20 to clear them (Wowhead).
Kokia Blazehoof: [탱버] Take Searing Blows (4 Physical strikes over 3 sec) with Shuffle up and clear it with Purifying Brew as soon as it ends. The Searing Wounds Fire DoT stacked by each strike only gets 58% Stagger, so line up Celestial Infusion.
[탱버] On high keys, use Fortifying Brew on any Searing Blows without Celestial Infusion, and stack both when they are up together (Topicx). Top yourself off with Expel Harm once Searing Wounds ends.
[위치] Kokia does not reset wherever you move her, so when Scorched Earth spreads wide, Roll ahead first and drag the boss well out onto clean ground (Wowhead).
[차단] Put Spear Hand Strike into Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley.
Kyrakka & Erkhart Stormvein: [탱버] Take Erkhart's Stormslam (Physical + Nature) with only Shuffle up and clear it with Purifying Brew right after. Save your defensives.

[탱버] If you are an Inferno Spit target, leave the party and use Celestial Infusion just before the circle explodes. If the Stormslam Nature vulnerability is still on you, take Interrupting Cloudburst with Celestial Infusion too.
[탱버] Save Fortifying Brew and Black Ox Brew for phase 2, when Inferno Spit targets three players.

Adderis & Aspix: [탱버] Keep Shuffle up during Overload, and use Celestial Infusion if things overlap.
[위치] After the Gale Force knockback, Roll back to your Thunder and Lightning soak spot.
[참고] Clear built-up Stagger with Purifying Brew before the soak window.
Merektha: [탱버] Take every Lightning Bite (3 sec cast, 533403 Physical + 7 sec Nature DoT) with Shuffle up and clear it with Purifying Brew right after. Line up Celestial Infusion for the Nature DoT whenever it is back, and use Black Ox Brew or Fortifying Brew when it is down.
[제어] When the two A Knot of Snakes targets group up, free them with Leg Sweep; free a lone target with Paralysis, Ring of Peace or Touch of Death (Wowhead).
[위치] Watch the egg positions on the floor just before Hatch and Provoke the Storm Serpent first so it cannot reach the DPS.
[차단] Kick Toxic Viper's Poison Spit with Spear Hand Strike and Detox any poison that lands.
Galvazzt: [위치] When Induction Field drops, Roll to the next corner first and move the boss around the four corners of the room in order.
[참고] Even if a beam is open, the tank does not soak it. Galvanized (250% increased Physical damage taken) is hard to survive even with Fortifying Brew (Wowhead).
[참고] Nothing targets the tank, so use Vivify on party members soaking beams when you have time.
Avatar of Sethraliss: [탱버] Take the first hit of Corrupted Guardian's Tainted Strike (484912 Physical + 25 sec Shadow DoT, stacking) with Shuffle and Purifying Brew, and use Celestial Infusion as the Shadow DoT stacks up.
[차단] Kick Twisted Hexxer's Flame Shock with Spear Hand Strike and pull the Hexxer next to the Corrupted Guardian with Provoke.
[제어] In phase 2, slow the healer-fixated Faithless Tormentors with Keg Smash, and when they reach the healer, stun them with Leg Sweep or push them away with Ring of Peace.
[참고] When you have time during the healing window, help heal the Avatar with Vivify (Wowhead).

115078.m: 특성 · 기력 20 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
115078.d: 대상을 1분 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 하나의 대상으로 제한됩니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 사라질 수 있습니다.

115178.d: 죽은 자의 영혼을 육체로 불러들여 최대 생명력과 마나의 35%를 지니고 살아나게 합니다. 전투 중에는 사용할 수 없습니다.

115181.d:
전방의 대상들에 불의 숨결을 내뿜어 (전투력의 100%)의 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 부가 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

맥주통 휘두르기의 영향을 받고 있는 대상은 불타올라 12초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 66%)의 화염 피해를 입고 당신에게 주는 피해가 5%만큼 감소합니다.

115203.d: 15초동안 피부가 돌로 변합니다.[받는 피해의 20%를 시간차로 받아 넘깁니다.]

115315.d:
대상 위치에 15분 동안 유지되는 흑우 조각상을 소환하여, 20미터 내의 모든 적을 향해 꾸준히 위협 수준을 생성합니다.

조각상을 대상으로 조롱을 시전하면 조각상 주위의 모든 적을 도발합니다.

115399.d: 흑우주를 마셔 즉시 기력을 모두 회복하고 정화주를 충전하며, 천신주 또는 천신의 주입의 충전 횟수가 1회 부여됩니다.

115546.d: 적을 도발하여 자신을 공격하게 합니다. 6초 동안 대상을 향해 생성되는 위협 수준이 800%만큼 증가합니다. [성급한 도발: 0%만큼 더 빠른 속도로 달려오게 만듭니다] [흑우 조각상 소환: 이 능력은 흑우 조각상을 대상으로 사용하여 조각상 10미터 내의 모든 적에게 같은 효과를 발휘하게 할 수 있습니다]

116670.d: 활기의 안개를 만들어내 대상의 생명력을 [(주문력의 258%)]만큼 회복 [활기의 안개: 시키고, 소생의 안개 효과를 받는 모든 아군의 생명력을 (주문력의 323.18%)만큼 회복시킵니다 / 시킵니다.]

116705.d: 손끝으로 적의 목을 찔러 주문 시전을 차단하고 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하지 못하게 만듭니다.

116841.d: 6초 동안 아군 대상의 이동 속도를 70%만큼 증가시키고 모든 이동 불가 및 이동 방해 효과를 제거합니다.

116844.d: 대상 위치에 5초 동안 평화의 고리를 형성합니다. 고리 안으로 들어선 적은 고리 밖으로 튕겨 나갑니다.

117906.d:
근접 공격에 적중당할 때마다, 또는 후려차기가 적에게 적중할 때마다 회피율이 7.0%만큼 증가하며, 이 효과는 중첩됩니다. 해당 효과는 공격 회피에 성공할 때까지 유지됩니다.

추가로 전투력이 8.0%만큼 증가합니다.

119381.d: 반경 6미터 안의 모든 적을 넘어뜨려 3초 동안 기절시킵니다.

119582.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
119582.d: 시간차 피해를 50%만큼, 혹은 최솟값으로 최대 생명력의 8%만큼 정화합니다.

121253.m: 특성 · 기력 40 · 15 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
121253.d:
맥주통을 휘둘러 주 대상에게 [(전투력의 190%) * (1.5)]의 물리 피해를 입히고, 8미터 내 다른 모든 적에게 (전투력의 190%)의 물리 피해를 입히고 15초 동안 이동 속도를 20%만큼 감소시킵니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

양조
Grants Shuffle for 5 sec and reduces the remaining cooldown on your Brews by 3 sec.

123986.m: 특성 · 1 초 주문 시전 시간 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
123986.d: 격류하는 기를 응축해 전방 40미터까지 날려 경로 내 모든 적에게 (전투력의 280%)의 자연 피해를 입히고 자신과 아군은 (전투력의 220%)만큼 치유합니다. 대상이 5명을 초과하면 치유량과 공격력이 감소합니다.

124502.d:
피해를 입을 때마다 일정 확률로 치유의 구슬을 생성합니다. 

치유의 구슬:
자신에게만 보이는 치유의 구슬을 생성합니다. 치유의 구슬을 통과하면 (전투력의 330%)의 생명력을 회복합니다.

132578.d:
흑우 니우짜오의 원령을 소환하여 25초 동안 주 대상을 공격하게 합니다. 후려차기를 시전할 때마다 원령이 땅 울리기를 사용하여 주위의 모든 적을 공격합니다.

활성화되어 있는 동안 시간차로 받아넘긴 피해의 40%를 니우짜오가 시간차로 받아넘기도록 하고, 니우짜오는 정화한 시간차 피해의 100%만큼 생명력을 회복합니다.

196736.d:
후려차기 사용 시 다음에 사용하는 능력이 강화됩니다.

 범의 장풍: 공격력이 100%만큼 증가합니다.

 맥주통 휘두르기: 맥주 능력의 남은 재사용 대기시간이 추가로 2초만큼 감소합니다.

205523.m: 즉시 · 4 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
205523.d: 기 에너지를 폭발시키며 공격하여 (전투력의 106.56%)의 물리 피해를 입 [특화: 교묘한 투사: 히고 3초 동안 건들건들 효과를 받습 / 힙]니다.

218164.m: 특성 · 기력 10 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
218164.d: 대상에게서 독과 질병 효과를 모두 제거합니다.

322101.m: 기력 15 / 1.4% (기본 마나 중) · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 15 초 재사용 대기시간
322101.d: 몸에서 적대적인 기를 방출하여 (주문력의 120%)의 생명력을 회복하고 20미터 내에 있는 적에게 치유량의 10%에 해당하는 자연 피해를 입힙니다. [해악 축출: 모든 치유의 구슬의 우호적인 기를 빨아들여 해악 축출의 치유량을 증가시킵니다] [해악 역전: [(주문력의 120%) + 30]의 기를 생성합니다.]

322109.d:
적 대상의 가장 취약한 약점을 노려 자신의 최대 생명력의 100%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다. [절명의 손길 연마: 자신보다 생명력이 낮은 생명체에게만 사용할 수 있습니다 / 

자신보다 생명력이 낮은 생명체에게만 사용할 수 있습니다.] [생명력이 15% 미만인 플레이어와 강력한 생명체에게는 자신의 최대 생명력의 35%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다] [절명의 손길: 입힌 피해의 200%만큼 시간차 피해를 감소시킵니다] [기의 구슬을 3개 생성하여, 구슬에 닿을 때마다 1의 기를 얻습니다] [10초 동안 수도사의 물리 공격력을 15%만큼 증가시킵니다]

322120.d:
니우짜오의 가르침을 체현하여 전투 중에 건들거려 시간차 효과를 100%만큼 증가시킵니다.

맥주통 휘두르기, 후려차기, 회전 학다리차기로 적을 공격하면 건들건들이 부여됩니다.

 시간차: 공격을 받아넘겨 민첩성에 따라 물리 피해의 일부를 10초에 걸쳐 입습니다. 마법 공격에는 58%의 효과를 발휘합니다. [니우짜오의 훈련: 현재 시간차 수준에 따라 특화가 최대 15%만큼 증가합니다.] (100밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

322729.m: 기력 25 · 집중 (1.5 초 주문 시전 시간)
322729.d: 공중 회전 발차기로 1.5초에 걸쳐 반경 8미터 내에 있는 적에게 [4 * (전투력의 10%)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. [회전 학다리차기: 회전 학다리차기로 피해를 입히면 1초 동안 건들건들 효과를 얻으며, 치유의 구슬을 자신의 위치로 끌어당깁니다]

325153.d:
대상 위치에 불타는 맥주통을 던져 주위 적들에게 (전투력의 380%)의 화염 피해를 입히고 기본 공격 시 (전투력의 30%)의 추가 화염 피해를 입힙니다. 다음 3초 동안 주위 적들의 근접 공격력이 100%만큼 감소합니다.

맥주통 휘두르기의 재사용 대기시간을 초기화합니다.

450508.d: 준 피해의 12%를, 유효 치유량의 6%를 활력으로 축적합니다.

450615.d: 자동 공격 시 일정 확률로 질풍격 충전물 1-2중첩을 생성합니다. 맥주통 휘두르기 시전 시 질풍격 충전물을 모두 방출해 하나당 (전투력의 60%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

1241059.m: 특성 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
1241059.d: 약초로 빚은 독한 술을 들이켜 신체에서 빠져나가는 정화된 기를 응축해 천신의 보호막을 형성합니다. 받는 피해의 30%만큼, 최대 0의 피해를 흡수합니다.

1262603.d: 흑우 니우짜오의 원령 시전 시 즉시 질풍격 10중첩이 부여되고 다음 공격 시 70%의 효율로 발동합니다.

1263245.d: 특화가 5%만큼 증가합니다. 흑우 니우짜오의 원령이 활성화된 동안에는 효과가 두 배로 증가합니다.

450892.d: 천신주 및 천신의 주입이 추가로 1회 충전됩니다.

383785.d: 적의 공격을 회피하거나 적의 공격이 빗나갈 때마다 다음 범의 장풍이나 회전 학다리차기의 공격력이 100%만큼 증가합니다. (1초 재사용 대기시간)

450992.d: 공격을 회피하거나 무기 막기에 성공하면 다음 6초 동안 받는 모든 피해가 8%만큼 감소합니다.

1: [탱버] Take Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike (533403 Physical) with Shuffle up, then clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after. Pop Invoke Niuzao (2 min) with Bloodlust so Niuzao takes 40% of your Stagger damage for 25 sec.
[탱버] Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret is Holy damage over 6 sec and Stagger only works at 58% against it, so use Celestial Infusion (1 min 30 sec).

[차단] Kicking Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley with Spear Hand Strike (15 sec) locks that school for 5 sec, so the caster walks to you. If it flees with Call The Grove at low health, stun it with Leg Sweep.
2: [탱버] Celestial Infusion from pull 1 needs 1 min 30 sec to return, so drink Black Ox Brew (2 min) before Spouting Floret to refill one Celestial Infusion charge and Purifying Brew, then use it. Master of Harmony has 2 charges from Endless Draught, so spend the remaining charge first.
[차단] Kick one Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley with Spear Hand Strike and stop the other's cast with Leg Sweep.
3: [탱버] Earthrupture Strike lands while Celestial Infusion is down, so take it with Fortifying Brew (6 min, 30 sec shorter with Expeditious Fortification) and clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew afterwards.
[참고] If Spore Spines slows from the 12 Lashers stack up, use Tiger's Lust (30 sec) on yourself to clear the snare.
5: [탱버] Pull Sporeblight Belcher first and use Celestial Infusion for Spouting Floret; take Virid Grovekeeper's Earthrupture Strike 5-6 sec later with Shuffle and Purifying Brew. If Invoke Niuzao is back, use it when you pull the Virid Grovekeeper.
[제어] Stop Thorny Saptor's Thornclaw Leap with Leg Sweep and kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Spear Hand Strike.
7: [탱버] Two Luminous Thornmaws alternate Grievous Gash (387930 Physical plus stacking bleed); if Fortifying Brew (5 min 30 sec) from pull 3 is back, use it on the pull together with Invoke Niuzao.

[탱버] The Grievous Gash bleed only drops at full health, so clear Stagger with Purifying Brew and top yourself off with Expel Harm (15 sec). If you get hit by Solar Breath (387930 Holy), use Celestial Infusion.
[제어] Stop both Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with one Leg Sweep.
8: [탱버] Use Celestial Infusion for Spouting Floret. If it has been less than 1 min 30 sec since pull 7, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew.
[제어] Stop the two Thorny Saptors' Thornclaw Leap with Leg Sweep. If Leg Sweep (1 min) from pull 7 is still on cooldown, Paralysis one Thorny Saptor before the pull.
10: [탱버] Take Potatoad Matriarch's Tongue Toss (290947 Physical, knock-up) with Shuffle up and clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew after you land.
[해제] Toxic Spew poisons the whole party, so Detox (8 sec) the lowest-health players one at a time (Wowhead).
[위치] It is easy to chain pull in this area, so do not use Summon Black Ox Statue here. The statue pulses threat to every enemy within 20 yards (Wowhead).
11: [탱버] Assign Celestial Infusion to Spouting Floret (Holy) and Shuffle plus Purifying Brew to Luminous Thornmaw's Grievous Gash (Physical). If Celestial Infusion is down, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew.
[제어] One Spear Hand Strike cannot stop three Lightfeather Petalwings' Disorienting Screech, so stun the gathered Petalwings with Leg Sweep.
12: [탱버] This is the last big pull, so use Invoke Niuzao and Celestial Infusion for Spouting Floret. Add Fortifying Brew if it is back.
[제어] If Radiant Spellsower flees with Call The Grove, stun it with Leg Sweep. A Lightgorged Lasher shielded by Lightbloom Pollination is immune to crowd control, so Leg Sweep will not land on it.

1: [탱버] Take the 7 Ravenous Descendants' Physical melee with Shuffle up, and pop Invoke Niuzao (2 min) with Exploding Keg (1 min) on Bloodlust. Exploding Keg makes nearby enemies' melee attacks deal 100% reduced damage for 3 sec.

[제어] The Ravenous Claws attack speed buff fades after 2 sec, so when stacks build, stun them for 3 sec with Leg Sweep to reset them. Tiger Tail Sweep extends its range to 10 yards, so you catch the whole gathered pack.
[차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Spear Hand Strike (15 sec).
2: [탱버] Use Celestial Infusion (1 min 30 sec) for Ritual Chieftain's Dismember (3 sec cast, 581895 Physical), then clear the Stagger with Purifying Brew right after the hit.
[탱버] Exploding Keg is back 1 min after pull 1, so throw it on the 4 Ravenous Descendants to shut off their melee damage for 3 sec.
[차단] Kick Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Spear Hand Strike.
3: [탱버] If less than 1 min 30 sec has passed since Celestial Infusion in pull 2, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew (2 min) and use it on Dismember. Master of Harmony has a second charge from Endless Draught, so spend that first.
[차단] Of the 3 Primal Serpents that walk down behind the pillar, kick one with Spear Hand Strike and stun the gathered rest with Leg Sweep to stop Piercing Hiss.
4: [탱버] Celestial Infusion and Black Ox Brew are both spent, so use Fortifying Brew (6 min, 5 min 30 sec with Expeditious Fortification) on Dismember.
[탱버] Throw Exploding Keg on the 4 Ravenous Descendants and reset their attack speed stacks with Leg Sweep if they build.
5: [탱버] This is the largest pull of the first section, so use Invoke Niuzao (back 2 min after pull 1) and put Celestial Infusion on Dismember.
[탱버] When Paralyzing Shots Nature DoTs from both Twinfang Harrowers overlap, Stagger only works at 58%, so top yourself off with Expel Harm (15 sec).
[참고] Twinfang Harrower's Duostrike replaces its melee, so Mastery: Elusive Brawler still dodges it, but it does not trigger Counterstrike or Predictive Training (Shado-Pan build) (Wowhead).
7: [탱버] Use Celestial Infusion for Rattling Writhe's Corrosive Fangs (242456 Nature, 20% increased damage taken for 20 sec). The following Rattle ignores armor but is Physical, so Stagger still absorbs it; clear it with Purifying Brew right after.

[차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Envenom right before Rattle with Spear Hand Strike and stop the Evolve channel with Leg Sweep. Gather the 3 Bloodletters into the same Leg Sweep to stop their melee for 3 sec.
8: [탱버] Use Celestial Infusion for Corrosive Fangs. If less than 1 min 30 sec has passed since pull 7, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew.
[제어] The 4 Bloodletters leave a blood pool with each melee hit, so stun them for 3 sec with Leg Sweep and move the pack out of the pools meanwhile.
9: [탱버] Use Celestial Infusion for Corrosive Fangs and add Invoke Niuzao if it is back from pull 5. If Celestial Infusion is down, refill a charge with Black Ox Brew.
[차단] Kick the near High Evolutionist's Envenom with Spear Hand Strike, and when both gather and channel Evolve, stop them together with Leg Sweep.
11: [차단] Take one of the 4 High Evolutionists with Spear Hand Strike, and stop the gathered pack's Evolve channels with Leg Sweep. If Leg Sweep is on cooldown, push them out with Ring of Peace (45 sec) to deny the Evolve heal (Wowhead).
[해제] Detox only cleanses one player every 8 sec, so remove Envenom from the lowest-health players first.
